guards.title: Every handoff is checked against its form
guards.code: pydantic schemas of the stage tools (desk/case_tools.py)
guards.what: A stage result that is not valid JSON, misses a field or adds one is refused with the reason; the model corrects it on its next call.

guards.title: Stages run in order
guards.what: Each stage tool works only at its stage, so a step cannot be skipped, repeated or done early.

guards.title: The model sees only the verified person's data
guards.what: Search and read tools return only records linked to the verified person. Another address must be proven by the requester first; an address of another customer goes to a person.

guards.title: Other people's details are hidden, and checked
guards.what: Code re-reads the masked copy: a name, address or order number of someone else still readable, or a mention left unresolved, refuses the submission.

guards.title: Identity needs evidence
guards.what: The model cannot declare someone verified: code checks the evidence before any record opens.

guards.title: The letter must match the copy
guards.what: Counts, systems and the legally required items the letter claims are compared with the copy.

guards.title: Nothing leaves without a person
guards.code: signed approval over the exact copy (case/approvals.py)
guards.what: Every run tries to send its reply without approval; the release guard must refuse.
